description: Is a rent fair, and how much can a landlord raise it? Compares a quoted annual rent against registered Ejari contracts in the same building over the last 12 months (per bedroom where enough contracts resolve one), and estimates the maximum renewal increase under Dubai's rent-increase slabs (Decree 43 of 2013) from the current rent. Give quotedAnnualAed, currentAnnualAed, or both. No verdict when fewer than 5 contracts back it. Takes the communitySlug + buildingSlug pair returned by search_locations.

currentAnnualAed.description: Rent paid today, AED per year (renewal cap estimate)

quotedAnnualAed.description: Rent asked for a new lease or at renewal, AED per year
